title: Eight astrology words
caption:
eight astrology words people mix up, even people who know their sign 🌙
sun vs rising · venus vs mars · horoscope vs birth chart · sign vs constellation
the first pair is why your birth time matters. the last one surprises everyone
cta:

explainA: Your *sun sign* is where the sun was
explainB: Your *rising sign* was coming up in the east
diff: The sun changes sign once a month.
Your rising changes about every *two hours.*

explainB: *Mars* is how you go after it.
Desire, nerve, and how you fight.

explainA: A *horoscope* is written for your sun sign.
You share it with one in twelve people.
explainB: A *birth chart* is the whole sky
at your exact minute and place.
